situations.title: 발작 관찰·시간 기록
situations.tagline: He started shaking again — someone please tell me how long this has been going on!
situations.brief: 발작의 지속시간과 양상을 관찰하고 정확히 기록하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm timing the seizure right now and watching exactly what's happening.
The duration and type help the team treat him correctly.
Thank you for calling us; I'm noting when it started.

situations.title: 발작 중 기도·안전 확보
situations.tagline: He might hurt himself thrashing like that — can you keep him safe?
situations.brief: 발작 중 손상을 예방하도록 기도와 안전을 확보하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm turning him on his side and protecting his head.
We keep the area clear and never put anything in his mouth.
I'm making sure his airway stays open.
goals: 발작 중 기도를 확보하고 흡인을 예방한다

situations.title: 벤조디아제핀 초기 투여 보조
situations.tagline: Is that the medicine that's finally going to stop his seizure?
situations.brief: 1차 약물인 벤조디아제핀의 초기 투여를 정확히 보조하세요.
keyPhrases: Yes, this benzodiazepine is our first-line medication to stop it.
Let's confirm the dose and give it now.
I'll watch his breathing closely after we give it.

situations.title: 활력·산소 감시
situations.tagline: His oxygen number is dropping while he seizes — is he getting enough air?
situations.brief: 발작 중 저산소를 예방하도록 활력징후와 산소를 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm applying oxygen and watching his saturation closely.
Seizures raise oxygen demand, so we support his breathing.
Let's keep suction and airway equipment ready.

situations.title: 혈당·전해질 확인
situations.tagline: Could low sugar or something in his blood be causing these seizures?
situations.brief: 유발 요인을 교정하도록 혈당과 전해질을 신속히 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's check a stat glucose and electrolytes right away.
A low sugar or sodium can trigger seizures.
If we find a cause, we correct it immediately.

situations.title: 발작 후 상태 사정
situations.tagline: The shaking stopped but he's still not himself — is that normal?
situations.brief: postictal 상태를 사정하고 회복 경과를 관찰하세요.
keyPhrases: After a seizure it's normal to be drowsy and confused for a while.
I'm checking his responsiveness as he recovers.
I'll watch closely for any sign of another seizure.

situations.title: 2차 항경련제 로딩
situations.tagline: The first medicine didn't fully stop it — are we loading a second drug now?
situations.brief: levetiracetam 등 2차 항경련제를 로딩 용량으로 투여하세요.
keyPhrases: Yes, we're loading a second anti-seizure drug like levetiracetam.
Let's confirm the weight-based dose and infusion rate.
I'll monitor his rhythm and pressure during the load.

situations.title: 지속 EEG 모니터 연계
situations.tagline: He's not shaking anymore, so why does he still need brainwave monitoring?
situations.brief: 비경련성 발작 감별을 위해 지속 EEG 모니터를 연계하세요.
keyPhrases: Seizures can continue in the brain even without shaking.
Continuous EEG lets us catch those hidden seizures.
The neuro team reads it to guide his treatment.

situations.title: 유발원인 검사·교정
situations.tagline: What set his brain off like this — an infection, or something in his blood?
situations.brief: 감염과 대사 이상 등 유발원인을 검사하고 교정하세요.
keyPhrases: We're testing for infection and metabolic causes together.
Correcting the trigger is key to stopping the seizures.
I'll send cultures and labs and treat what we find.
goals: 감염과 대사 이상 등 유발원인을 검사한다

situations.title: 반복 발작 약물 단계화
situations.tagline: He keeps seizing over and over — what's the next drug on the ladder?
situations.brief: escalation ladder에 따라 반복 발작에 약물을 단계적으로 투여하세요.
keyPhrases: We follow a stepwise ladder when seizures keep recurring.
After benzos and the second agent, we consider infusions.
Let's have the next medication ready to give without delay.

situations.title: 기도확보 준비·삽관 판단
situations.tagline: He's getting so drowsy between seizures — are we close to needing to intubate?
situations.brief: 의식저하에 대비해 기도확보를 준비하고 삽관 시점을 판단하세요.
keyPhrases: His declining consciousness may mean he can't protect his airway.
Let's have intubation equipment and the team ready.
If he deteriorates further, we'll secure the airway.
goals: 의식저하 시 기도 보호 능력을 평가한다

situations.title: 항경련제 혈중농도·부작용
situations.tagline: Are his seizure medicine levels where they should be, and any side effects to watch?
situations.brief: 항경련제 혈중농도와 부작용을 모니터하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's check his drug levels to confirm they're therapeutic.
I'm watching for sedation, low pressure, and rhythm changes.
We'll adjust the dose based on levels and his response.

situations.title: 비경련성 SE 인지
situations.tagline: He hasn't woken up like we expected — could he still be seizing somehow?
situations.brief: 의식저하가 지속될 때 비경련성 SE를 감별하여 인지하세요.
keyPhrases: Persistent unresponsiveness can mean ongoing nonconvulsive seizures.
Let's get an urgent EEG to check his brain activity.
I'll flag this to the neuro team right away.

situations.title: 발작 관련 손상·흡인 관리
situations.tagline: He bit his tongue and may have breathed in some saliva — what do we do about that?
situations.brief: 발작 관련 손상과 흡인 등 합병증을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's suction gently and check his airway and mouth.
I'm watching for signs of aspiration like low oxygen or fever.
We'll assess for any injuries from the seizure.
goals: 발작 관련 손상과 흡인을 평가하고 관리한다

situations.title: 원인별 치료 연계
situations.tagline: They mentioned a stroke or a tumor might be behind this — what happens next?
situations.brief: 뇌졸중과 종양 등 병인에 따른 치료를 연계하고 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: We're identifying the cause, whether it's a stroke or a mass.
The treatment depends on what we find on imaging.
The neuro team will guide the next steps with us.

situations.title: 불응성 SE 마취약 주입 위기
situations.tagline: The other drugs failed — are we putting him on a continuous anesthesia drip now?
situations.brief: 불응성 SE에 midazolam이나 propofol 지속주입을 시작하고 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: Yes, we're starting a continuous midazolam or propofol infusion.
This requires the airway secured and close hemodynamic monitoring.
I'll titrate to seizure control on EEG.

situations.title: 초불응성 SE 관리
situations.tagline: Even the anesthesia drip isn't holding it — what more can we possibly do?
situations.brief: 초불응성 SE에 다약제와 burst suppression 목표로 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: We add another agent and target burst suppression on EEG.
Let's keep his pressure supported as we deepen the infusion.
The neuro team will guide the depth and duration.
goals: 초불응성 SE에 다약제와 burst suppression을 적용한다

situations.title: 발작 중 심한 저산소·서맥 위기
situations.tagline: His oxygen crashed and his heart rate is dropping while he seizes — help now!
situations.brief: 발작 중 심한 저산소와 서맥에 기도확보와 소생으로 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Open the airway and bag him with high-flow oxygen now.
Call for help and prepare for intubation.
Watch the heart rate and be ready to escalate resuscitation.
goals: 발작 중 심한 저산소와 서맥을 즉시 인지한다

situations.title: 발작 후 뇌부종·ICP 위기
situations.tagline: After all those seizures he looks worse — could his brain be swelling now?
situations.brief: 발작 후 뇌부종과 ICP 상승에 의한 신경 악화에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Prolonged seizures can cause brain swelling and raised pressure.
I'm elevating his head and rechecking his neuro exam.
Let's get imaging and consider osmotic therapy.
goals: 발작 후 뇌부종과 ICP 상승을 인지한다

situations.title: 항경련 마취 중 혈역학 붕괴
situations.tagline: His pressure is bottoming out on the propofol drip — we're losing him hemodynamically.
situations.brief: 항경련 마취 중 혈역학 붕괴에 승압과 균형으로 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Start a pressor and give fluid to support his pressure.
We balance seizure control against his hemodynamics.
Let's reassess the infusion rate with the team.
goals: 마취약 주입 중 혈역학 붕괴를 인지한다

situations.title: 지속 SE 예후·목표 소통
situations.tagline: It's been going on so long — I need to know honestly, what are we hoping for now?
situations.brief: 지속 SE의 예후와 치료 목표를 가족과 신중히 상담하세요.
keyPhrases: The prolonged seizures are serious, and I'll be honest with you.
The team will explain what recovery might look like.
Let's talk about his wishes and what matters most to him.
